title: Episode 48
logline: While feigning submission after her public humiliation, Catherine schemes in secret, plotting to use the council's ten-day reprieve to strike back at Alexander and Juliana with the aid of Father Thomas.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 47's public disgrace where Catherine bowed to Juliana and accepted the position of a maid; in private, Catherine sheds her feigned defeat and initiates her counter-plot.

Catherine, adorned in an ornate dark burgundy gown with braided golden hair, gazes out the dark window before turning slowly with a cold, venomous smirk.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Vindictive, Cold):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:02.40) | End: (00:07.50)
"Two words, and that healer's crown rolls right back into the gutter where it belongs."

Start: (00:04.50) | End: (00:08.50)
Close-up on Catherine's profile and jewelry as she speaks with calculating contempt.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:04.50) | End: (00:08.50)
Close-up on Catherine's profile and jewelry as she speaks with calculating contempt.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:07.80) | End: (00:12.30)
Catherine glides across the chamber past a roaring stone hearth, picking up an orange from a silver platter on the table.
blocks.action:
Start: (00:07.80) | End: (00:12.30)
Catherine glides across the chamber past a roaring stone hearth, picking up an orange from a silver platter on the table.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Scheming):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:08.00) | End: (00:12.30)
"Ten days. He gave himself ten days to fix it."

Start: (00:12.30) | End: (00:20.00)
Medium close-up frontal shot of Catherine turning directly toward the viewer, her expression tightening into ruthless determination.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:12.30) | End: (00:20.00)
Medium close-up frontal shot of Catherine turning directly toward the viewer, her expression tightening into ruthless determination.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Intense, Measured):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:12.60) | End: (00:14.90)
"Ten days for the council to sit."

Start: (00:15.00) | End: (00:18.50)
Catherine raises a gloved index finger, emphasizing each point with sinister precision.
blocks.action:
Start: (00:15.00) | End: (00:18.50)
Catherine raises a gloved index finger, emphasizing each point with sinister precision.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Calculating):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:15.10) | End: (00:17.20)
"Ten days for witnesses to be gathered."

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Dark, Threatening):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:17.40) | End: (00:19.70)
"Ten days for a decree to be undone."

Start: (00:20.00) | End: (00:26.70)
Slight push-in on Catherine as she clenches her fist against her chest, her eyes blazing with malice.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:20.00) | End: (00:26.70)
Slight push-in on Catherine as she clenches her fist against her chest, her eyes blazing with malice.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Menacing, Resolute):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:20.10) | End: (00:23.70)
"Ten days is not a wall, Alexander. It's a door."

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Chillingly Calm):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:23.90) | End: (00:26.50)
"And doors can be closed from the other side."

Start: (00:26.70) | End: (00:30.80)
Medium shot over Catherine's shoulder seated before her vanity mirror as the chamber door eases open and Agnes enters quietly.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:26.70) | End: (00:30.80)
Medium shot over Catherine's shoulder seated before her vanity mirror as the chamber door eases open and Agnes enters quietly.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:26.80) | End: (00:29.50)
Agnes, dressed in a grey maid's dress and white apron, steps inside with cautious hesitation and clasps her hands.
blocks.action:
Start: (00:26.80) | End: (00:29.50)
Agnes, dressed in a grey maid's dress and white apron, steps inside with cautious hesitation and clasps her hands.

blocks.speaker: AGNES (Hushed, Submissive):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:29.20) | End: (00:30.80)
"You sent for me, my lady?"

Start: (00:32.00) | End: (00:33.90)
Close-up on Agnes's hands turning the ornate iron key in the wooden door's brass lock.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:32.00) | End: (00:33.90)
Close-up on Agnes's hands turning the ornate iron key in the wooden door's brass lock.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:32.30) | End: (00:33.80)
Heavy metallic click of an iron key latching into a deadbolt.
blocks.action:
Start: (00:32.30) | End: (00:33.80)
Heavy metallic click of an iron key latching into a deadbolt.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:34.00) | End: (00:36.50)
Catherine strides forward and firmly grasps Agnes by both hands, stepping uncomfortably close.
blocks.action:
Start: (00:34.00) | End: (00:36.50)
Catherine strides forward and firmly grasps Agnes by both hands, stepping uncomfortably close.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:34.00) | End: (00:43.00)
Two-shot profile of Catherine towering over Agnes in the candlelight.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:34.00) | End: (00:43.00)
Two-shot profile of Catherine towering over Agnes in the candlelight.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Fierce, Hissing):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:34.20) | End: (00:37.10)
"Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today."

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Spiteful, calculating):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:37.30) | End: (00:39.00)
"Good. Let them remember it."

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Sinister, Predatory):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:39.20) | End: (00:43.00)
"Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now."

Start: (00:43.00) | End: (00:46.80)
Over-the-shoulder close-up on Agnes, her brow furrowed in anxious alarm.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:43.00) | End: (00:46.80)
Over-the-shoulder close-up on Agnes, her brow furrowed in anxious alarm.

blocks.speaker: AGNES (Anxious, Whispering):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:43.30) | End: (00:46.80)
"My lady... the Duke has bailiffs watching every road out of the county."

Start: (00:46.80) | End: (00:51.50)
Close-up on Catherine, a smug, venomous smile spreading across her painted lips.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:46.80) | End: (00:51.50)
Close-up on Catherine, a smug, venomous smile spreading across her painted lips.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Confident, Devious):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:47.00) | End: (00:51.30)
"I'm not leaving the county, Agnes. I'm going back into that house."

Start: (00:51.50) | End: (00:58.20)
Medium tracking shot following Catherine as she releases Agnes and stalks across the room toward the window sill.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:51.50) | End: (00:58.20)
Medium tracking shot following Catherine as she releases Agnes and stalks across the room toward the window sill.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Pleased, Scheming):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:52.00) | End: (00:55.00)
"Father Thomas did his part beautifully today."

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Calculated, Demanding):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:55.20) | End: (00:58.20)
"Now I need him to do a little more before that hearing convenes."

Start: (00:58.20) | End: (01:01.00)
Medium close-up of Agnes glancing nervously over her shoulder.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:58.20) | End: (01:01.00)
Medium close-up of Agnes glancing nervously over her shoulder.

blocks.speaker: AGNES (Apprehensive):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:58.50) | End: (01:00.60)
"If someone sees him come to you..."

Start: (01:01.00) | End: (01:06.90)
Close-up on Catherine spinning around from the window, her jaw set in terrifying firmness.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:01.00) | End: (01:06.90)
Close-up on Catherine spinning around from the window, her jaw set in terrifying firmness.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Stern, Threatening):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:01.80) | End: (01:04.00)
"Then no one sees him."

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Authoritative):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:04.30) | End: (01:06.90)
"That is precisely your job tonight."

Start: (01:06.90) | End: (01:13.50)
Medium shot as Catherine picks up a heavy velvet coin purse and places it firmly into Agnes's awaiting open palms.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:06.90) | End: (01:13.50)
Medium shot as Catherine picks up a heavy velvet coin purse and places it firmly into Agnes's awaiting open palms.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:07.50) | End: (01:09.00)
Dull clinking of heavy gold coins inside a leather pouch.
blocks.action:
Start: (01:07.50) | End: (01:09.00)
Dull clinking of heavy gold coins inside a leather pouch.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Hushed, Commanding):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:07.80) | End: (01:10.50)
"Send for the priest. Tonight."

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Firm, Final):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:10.80) | End: (01:13.40)
"And make sure no one sees him arrive."

Start: (01:13.50) | End: (01:16.80)
Wide shot of Agnes curtsying swiftly, stashing the pouch into her apron, and hurrying out through the heavy wooden door into the darkness.
